verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents API reference pages for the CKS API and the Inference API, along with generated clients. None of the evidence shows an interactive explorer, a try-it console, or runnable examples inside the reference. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec that would typically back an interactive reference. A static reference is adjacent to this story but does not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
